ARALE_QUEST_DREAM_PEAK: Reach at least {N} [gold]Dream[/gold] at any point in a combat
ARALE_QUEST_DREAM_TOTAL: Gain a total of {N} [gold]Dream[/gold] this run
ARALE_QUEST_DREAM_ZERO: Have your [gold]Dream[/gold] consumed down to 0 a total of {N} times this run
ARALE_QUEST_DREAM_STREAK: Reach at least {N} [gold]Dream[/gold] at some point in each of {M} consecutive combats
ARALE_QUEST_DREAM_TWIST: Play no [gold]Attacks[/gold] for an entire combat, and reach at least {N} [gold]Dream[/gold] during it
ARALE_QUEST_TRAIN_PEAK: Accumulate {N} stacks of [gold]Training[/gold] in a single combat
ARALE_QUEST_LULU_TOTAL: Enter [gold]Magic Lulu[/gold] form a total of {N} times this run
ARALE_QUEST_LULU_STREAK: Enter [gold]Magic Lulu[/gold] form in each of {M} consecutive combats
ARALE_QUEST_LULU_MULTI: Enter [gold]Magic Lulu[/gold] form {N} times in a single combat
ARALE_QUEST_SONG_PEAK: Apply a total of {N} [gold]Song[/gold] stacks in a single combat
ARALE_QUEST_SONG_TOTAL: Apply a total of {N} [gold]Song[/gold] stacks this run
ARALE_QUEST_INTOX_LAYERS: Generate a total of {N} [gold]Intoxication[/gold] stacks this run
ARALE_QUEST_SONG_STREAK: Apply a total of at least {N} [gold]Song[/gold] stacks in each of {M} consecutive combats
ARALE_QUEST_INTOX_HP: Cause a total of {N} HP loss through [gold]Intoxication[/gold] in a single combat
ARALE_QUEST_RETAIN_PEAK: Have {N} cards with [gold]Retain[/gold] in your hand at the same time during a combat
ARALE_QUEST_RETAIN_TOTAL: [gold]Retain[/gold] cards a total of {N} times this run (counted each turn)
ARALE_QUEST_RETAIN_PLAYED: Play cards with [gold]Retain[/gold] a total of {N} times this run
ARALE_QUEST_RETAIN_STREAK: Have at least {N} cards with [gold]Retain[/gold] in hand at once during each of {M} consecutive combats
ARALE_QUEST_RETAIN_TWIST: Play no [gold]Attacks[/gold] for an entire combat, and hold at least {N} cards with [gold]Retain[/gold] at once during it
ARALE_QUEST_GEN_NO_DAMAGE: Complete {M} consecutive combats without losing HP
ARALE_QUEST_GEN_SHOP_GOLD: Enter any shop with at least {N} Gold this run
ARALE_QUEST_GEN_WIN_NO_ATTACK: Win {N} combats this run without playing any [gold]Attacks[/gold] throughout each one (not necessarily consecutive)
ARALE_QUEST_GEN_CURSES: Have at least {N} [gold]Curses[/gold] in your deck at the end of any combat
ARALE_QUEST_GEN_KILLS: Defeat a total of {N} enemies this run
ARALE_QUEST_GEN_CARDS: Play a total of {N} cards this run
ARALE_QUEST_UI_EXPAND: Expand quests (drag the star to move)
ARALE_QUEST_UI_STREAK_RESET: A combat that fails the requirement resets the streak.
ARALE_QUEST_UI_NO_ATTACK_OK: No Attacks played so far. Playing any before combat ends invalidates this attempt, even after reaching the target.
ARALE_QUEST_UI_NO_ATTACK_FAILED: No-Attacks condition: failed for this combat.
ARALE_QUEST_UI_NO_ATTACK_RULE: No Attacks for the entire combat, even after reaching the target. You can try again in a later combat.
ARALE_QUEST_UI_SETTLEMENT: Checked at the end of combat.
ARALE_QUEST_UI_PEAK_RULE: Uses the highest value reached during combat; you do not need to maintain it until combat ends.
ARALE_QUEST_UI_RETAIN_RULE: Includes Retain granted for this turn; the card need not have Retain originally.
ARALE_QUEST_UI_RETAIN_COUNT_RULE: Counted at each turn end. Retaining the same card across multiple turns counts again each turn.
ARALE_QUEST_UI_NO_HP_LOSS_RULE: HP loss from any source counts; healing afterward does not undo it. A failed combat resets the streak.
ARALE_QUEST_UI_KILLS_RULE: Counts enemy deaths, including enemies defeated by allies in multiplayer.
